newsitem.title: USA: Hills Stores fiscal Dec samestore sales fall.
newsitem.headline: Hills Stores fiscal Dec samestore sales fall.

text.p: Hills Stores Co said Friday that same-store sales fell by 7.7 percent for the four fiscal weeks ending December 28 this year when compared against the previous year's fiscal period ending December 23.
It said that for the calendar priod ending December 28, same-store sales rose by 4.4 percent when compared to the figure for the calendar period ending December 30 last year.
The company did not provide further sales figures and did not immediately return calls.
